records.actual_complete_printed_type:
@MSCI.RootPair.moment_formula : ∀ {c onset rate : ℝ},
  0 < c → 0 < rate → MSCI.RootPair.moment c onset rate = Real.exp (-c * onset) * rate / (rate + c)
records.name: ResearchCommons.MSCI.RootPair.moment_formula

records.actual_complete_printed_type:
@MSCI.RootPair.scaled_moments_injective : ∀ {c b b' r r' : ℝ},
  0 < c →
    0 < b →
      0 < b' →
        0 < r →
          0 < r' →
            b * r / (r + c) = b' * r' / (r' + c) →
              b ^ 2 * r / (r + 2 * c) = b' ^ 2 * r' / (r' + 2 * c) → b = b' ∧ r = r'
records.name: ResearchCommons.MSCI.RootPair.scaled_moments_injective

records.actual_complete_printed_type:
@MSCI.RootPair.moments_injective : ∀ {c t t' r r' : ℝ},
  0 < c →
    0 < r →
      0 < r' →
        MSCI.RootPair.moment c t r = MSCI.RootPair.moment c t' r' →
          MSCI.RootPair.moment (2 * c) t r = MSCI.RootPair.moment (2 * c) t' r' → t = t' ∧ r = r'
records.name: ResearchCommons.MSCI.RootPair.moments_injective
